messages:
Riley Adams: Quick sync 10/20 benchmark teaser + webinar. Need social copy + one hero image + seedlist by EOD. Can someone take creative and ops?
Priya Nair: Ill prep seedlist. Target = infra PMs, ML platform leads, startup CTOs. Will dedupe CRM and tag timezone. Link when ready.
Juno Park: Ill write copy. Suggest a short X thread + a LinkedIn long-form. Want to A/B headline on X: Variant Cost vs Variant Latency.
Marco Silva: Ops can handle scheduling & boosts. Proposed boost $500 split 60/40 X/LI. Run 6h from publish. Will need final tweet IDs to split test.
Elsa Kim: Creative ask: 1 hero (1200x628) + 1 benchmark slide (1200x1200). Small alt-text file too. Will upload once copy locked.
Riley Adams: CTA = "Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar/oct2025" Use UTMs: utm_campaign=octbench2025&utm_medium=social&utm_source=twitter|linkedin&utm_content={A|B} 
Priya Nair: Seedlist draft: https://drive.google.com/seed/octbench_seed.csv  includes priority flags. Will hand to SDRs post-publish.
Juno Park: Draft X thread: 1) "New benchmark: configs that lower inference cost without killing latency. Live demo 10/20. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/webinar/oct2025 #MLInfra" 2) "Well show batching, caching, and quantization lessons that are safe for production." 3) "Pin: registration + 3 bullet takeaways."
Marco Silva: Scheduling snippet: X root -> 2025-10-20 10:00 PT; X pinned reply (register+slide) -> immediate; LI long post -> 10:05 PT; Boost start -> 10:00 PT. Ops will pin the reply.
Elsa Kim: Assets uploaded: https://drive.google.com/creative/octbench_assets (files: hero_cost.png, hero_latency.png, slide_bench_v1.png, alt_text.txt)
Riley Adams: Well A/B headline on X (cost vs latency). Use hero_cost for A and hero_latency for B. Marco, please ensure Buffer uses correct image per variant.
Marco Silva: Noted. Buffer will map asset A -> tweet A, asset B -> tweet B. I'll also set paid split 60% X / 40% LI.
Priya Nair: Engagement rules: tag high-intent replies (pricing/scale asks) -> SDRs follow within 24h. Clickers who dont attend -> SDR follow within 24h.
Juno Park: Pin reply copy will be short bullets + registration. Also request analytics tag octbench2025 in all UTMs and paid configs.
ops-bot: Reminder: publish checklist due 2025-10-20 09:00 PT. Campaign created: octbench2025.
Elsa Kim: Small accessibility note: added alt text and short captions for the slide.
Riley Adams: Final checklist: copy locked by 16:00 PT, assets uploaded, seedlist final, ops scheduled. If no objections were green to publish.
Marco Silva: All set from ops. Leaving thread open for last tweaks. :rocket:
